MemeDef.label: Isolationism
MemeDef.description: The spread of faith, culture and knowledge only hinders our society.

rulesStrings.li: memeAdjective->true
memeAdjective->real
memeHyphenPrefix->truth
memeConcept->truth
memeLeaderNoun->speaker
memeMoralist->isolationist
creation(tag=meme_Isolationism) ->[deity0_name] anointed a few among mortals to carry [deity0_possessive] word.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Isolationism) ->[deity0_name] said to all the [memberNamePlural], "Go forth and spread my word to all corners of the universe."
intro(tag=meme_Isolationism) ->[memberNamePlural] built a great [altarName] on the [place_summary] [place_name], so that many would come to hear [deity0_name]'s divine word.

conflict(tag=meme_Isolationism) ->A spiteful [foeLeader], seeking to deny the word of [deity0_name], told [foeLeader_possessive] [foeSoldiers] to cut out the tongues of any who speak of the [deity0_type].
founderJoin(tag=meme_Isolationism) ->[deity0_name] blessed a [place_job] named [founderName] with great charisma, and none could turn away when [founder_pronoun] spoke.
victory(tag=meme_Isolationism) ->[founderName] admonished the [foeSoldiers] and reminded them of [deity0_name]'s power, and they put down their [place_personalWeapon]s.
setup(tag=meme_Isolationism) ->Our founder [founderName] was a great orator, converting thousands as [founder_pronoun] traveled between the cities.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_Isolationism) ->The believers moved between cities and institutions, spreading word of the new righteousness.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_Isolationism) ->In all my years spreading our truth, I learned one lesson that stands over all:
lesson(tag=meme_Isolationism) ->keeping this good news to ourselves would be a crime
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Isolationism) ->This is the fact we need to spread, and spread, and spread - to all the people, may they rejoice!
archistBasis(tag=meme_Isolationism) ->The archotechs announce their presence from the sky, and in the mind, and obviously wish to be known by all.
archistFact(tag=meme_Isolationism) ->Archotechs touch those who believe, and use them as conduits to spread wisdom to the others.
archistProphecy(tag=meme_Isolationism) ->[inTheEnd], the archotechs will voice their final wisdom to the holder of the [relic0_name], who must preach this wisdom to those who would listen.
animistFact(tag=meme_Isolationism) ->The spirits want to be known, but only speak to a few. They want us to reveal the truth to others.
